title: Time
description: A self-contained clock Thing: its actions run on the in-process time handler that ships with thingctx, so it works offline with no credentials and no device.

getCurrentTime.description: Current time in an IANA timezone (default UTC).

timezone.description: IANA timezone name, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Defaults to UTC.

convertTime.description: Convert a time between IANA timezones. Accepts a bare wall-clock time (HH:MM or HH:MM:SS, taken as today) or a full ISO 8601 stamp.

time.description: The time to convert: HH:MM[:SS] or ISO 8601.

source_timezone.description: IANA timezone the input time is in.
